home.subtitle: Enter your details, paste the job listing – BewerbungsKI instantly creates your CV and cover letter. In English, German or 6 other languages – you choose.
home.step1Text: Name, experience, skills – enter once and reuse for every application.
home.step2Text: Copy job title and description – the AI tailors everything individually.
home.step3Text: Both documents ready instantly – professional, personalised, application-ready. Download as DOCX.
home.germanNote: Your application in 8 languages – e.g. in German, perfect for the German job market.
home.freeBadge: 1 application free – no credit card needed
home.feat1Desc: Modern, Classic, Executive, Creative and more – choose the style that suits you.
home.feat2Desc: The AI matches keywords to the job listing – for more interview invitations.
home.feat3Desc: German, English, Arabic and 5 more – perfect for international applications.
home.feat4Desc: Just paste your LinkedIn profile – the AI extracts all data automatically.
home.feat5Desc: Download a Word file instantly and edit it further if needed.
home.feat6Desc: Add a professional photo directly to your CV – optional.
home.faq1A: 1 application is free forever – no credit card. After that, a one-time €9.99 for 10 more applications.
home.faq2A: The AI analyses your profile and the job listing and writes genuine, individual text – no templates, no filler phrases.
home.faq3A: Your data is stored encrypted and never shared with third parties. No tracking, no ads – GDPR-compliant.
home.faq4A: Yes – after generation you can edit the CV and cover letter directly in the app and download them again.
home.ctaBottomSub: 1 application free – no credit card, no subscription.
